notes.title: Past Mistakes – Episode 2 v0.2: Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hey hey everyone! It's that time again! 🙂🍾

We’re super excited to finally share the release date for Episode 2 v0.2 of Past Mistakes! 🏆

The new update is scheduled for release on the same day as the Steam Autumn Sale, September 29th. Don't miss your chance to grab a copy if you haven't already!  As always thank you so much for your support! 💜

notes.title: Just 2 Days! Past Mistakes - Act I Release Date
notes.notes:
The wait is almost over!


We can finally reveal that Past Mistakes – Act I launches this Wednesday (July 30) on Steam!


🚨 Special Discount

To celebrate, we're kicking things off with a special 20% launch discount  — so don’t miss it!



💎 New DLC Content

Two new DLCs for Past Mistakes are also now listed on Steam — and they’ll both be available at launch!

Soundtrack – Includes all current tracks from Act I, with more added as new episodes release. 

Walkthrough & Cheats – In-game tools + a full guide to help you explore every route and unlock hidden content.



Add Past Mistakes - Act I to your wishlist now to be notified the moment it goes live.



Let’s make this release a big one!



Cock-N-Tiel Studios Team
